title: La chanson du rangement avec Lulu

references.title: La chanson du rangement (Little Baby Bum)

inspiration.why: Theme tres recherche par les parents, peu de versions animees recentes en francais (la 3e depasse a peine 1 M de vues). Chanson, histoire et personnages originaux.

style: Pixar-style 3D children's cartoon, soft night-time lighting with warm golden firefly glow, cozy, wide 16:9 framing, no text.

characters.Nino: 4-year-old boy with fluffy light-brown hair, big round hazel eyes, rosy cheeks, light blue pajamas with little white stars, barefoot.
characters.Lulu: small cute firefly girl with big brown eyes, a pink bow on her head, two antennae with white pompoms, translucent wings and a softly glowing warm yellow belly.

setting: the same cozy child's bedroom at night: bed with wooden frame, window with the moon, wall shelves with books, an open wooden toy chest on the right, soft rug.

lines: Chut… il fait tout noir ici !
Qui se cache sous le lit ?
sections.start_frame: Very dark bedroom, only moonlight. Nino sits up in bed, curious and a little shy, holding his blanket. Lulu is a tiny golden glow near the window. Toys are hidden in the shadows.
sections.end_frame: The bedroom is still dark. Lulu flies in front of Nino, glowing brighter, smiling. Nino, sitting on his bed, looks at her with wide amazed eyes.
sections.motion: Lulu flies slowly from the window towards Nino, her glow growing brighter; Nino leans forward with wonder.

lines: regarde bien ce qui est là !
sections.end_frame: Nino stands on the rug in the middle of the messy room, dancing with his arms up, Lulu dances in the air above him, golden sparkles around them.
sections.motion: Nino jumps out of bed and dances joyfully on the rug with Lulu, who twirls in the air leaving golden sparkles.

lines: Un, dans le coffre, hop là !
sections.end_frame: Nino, smiling proudly, drops a red ball into the room's only toy chest (the wooden chest on the right side of the room, now open), Lulu glows above the chest.
sections.motion: Lulu shines her light under the bed, Nino kneels and pulls out a red ball, then runs and drops it into the wooden toy chest on the right.

lines: Deux, dans le coffre, hop là !
sections.end_frame: Nino drops a yellow rubber duck into the room's only toy chest (the wooden chest on the right side of the room, now open), laughing, Lulu glows above the chest.
sections.motion: Lulu lights the curtain, a yellow rubber duck appears at its foot, Nino picks it up with a laugh and puts it in the wooden toy chest on the right.

lines: regarde bien ce qui est là !
sections.end_frame: Nino dances on the rug clapping his hands, Lulu twirls above him, the floor is already less messy.
sections.motion: Nino and Lulu dance and clap in rhythm on the rug, golden sparkles float around.

lines: Trois, dans le coffre, hop là !
sections.end_frame: Nino puts an armful of colorful wooden blocks into the room's only toy chest (the wooden chest on the right side of the room, now open), Lulu glows above.
sections.motion: Lulu lights the rug where colorful blocks are scattered, Nino gathers them in his arms and puts them in the wooden toy chest on the right.

lines: Nounours, lui, vient dans mon lit !
sections.end_frame: Nino stands by his bed hugging a brown teddy bear tenderly, eyes closed with a happy smile, Lulu glows next to him. The wooden toy chest is closed. The wall shelf now holds only books: there is no teddy bear on the shelf anymore (Nino has the only teddy bear).
sections.motion: Lulu lights the shelf, a brown teddy bear appears, Nino takes it down and hugs it tenderly, then closes the wooden toy chest on the right with his foot.

lines: regarde bien ce qui est là !
sections.end_frame: The room is perfectly tidy: the floor is completely clear and the single wooden toy chest on the right is CLOSED. Nino sways happily holding his brown teddy bear in his arms, Lulu dances in the air above him, warm golden glow fills the room. The wall shelf holds only books.
sections.motion: Nino sways and dances gently with his teddy bear in the tidy room, Lulu twirls happily.

sections.end_frame: The perfectly tidy bedroom at night, the floor is completely clear, the single wooden toy chest is closed. Nino is lying in his bed under the blanket, head on the pillow, eyes closed, fast asleep, holding his brown teddy bear in his arms inside the bed. Nothing on the floor. Lulu sits alone on the window sill, glowing softly like a night light. Stars twinkle outside. Exactly one boy and one firefly, no other creature.
sections.motion: Nino climbs into bed with his teddy bear and falls asleep, Lulu flies to the window sill and dims her glow softly; slow camera pull back.

youtube.title: La chanson du rangement 🧸 Range ta chambre avec Lulu la Luciole | Comptine pour enfants
youtube.hook:
✨ Chut… il fait tout noir dans la chambre de Nino ! Qui se cache sous le lit ?
Lulu la Luciole allume sa petite lumière et, un, deux, trois, chaque jouet retrouve sa place : le ballon, le canard, les cubes… et Nounours ?

Une comptine originale pour apprendre à ranger en chantant, compter jusqu'à trois et se préparer pour dormir. Chante et range avec Nino et Lulu !
